# Input tools

7 tools. Registered under `GODOT_MCP_PROFILE=core`.

[← All categories](README.md)

## `simulate_key_press`

Inject a keyboard event into the running game

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|:---:|---|
| `key` | `string` | yes | Key name, e.g. 'Space', 'Enter', 'A', 'Escape', 'Left', 'F1' |
| `pressed` | `boolean` | — | true = key down, false = key up (default: true) |
| `shift` | `boolean` | — | Shift modifier (default: false) |
| `ctrl` | `boolean` | — | Ctrl modifier (default: false) |
| `alt` | `boolean` | — | Alt modifier (default: false) |
| `echo` | `boolean` | — | Treat as auto-repeat echo event (default: false) |

**Example** — the call the suite makes, from `e2e/blocks/06-input.json`, test I-01:

```json
{
  "key": "A",
  "pressed": true
}
```

## `simulate_mouse_click`

Inject a mouse button event at a screen position

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|:---:|---|
| `x` | `number` | yes | X position in the viewport (pixels) |
| `y` | `number` | yes | Y position in the viewport (pixels) |
| `button` | `string` | — | Which mouse button (default: left) One of: `"left"`, `"right"`, `"middle"`. |
| `pressed` | `boolean` | — | true = button down, false = button up (default: true). Pass false for a full click. |
| `double_click` | `boolean` | — | Simulate a double-click (default: false) |

**Example** — the call the suite makes, from `e2e/blocks/06-input.json`, test I-04:

```json
{
  "x": 400,
  "y": 300,
  "button": "left"
}
```

## `simulate_mouse_move`

Inject a mouse motion event to move the cursor to a screen position

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|:---:|---|
| `x` | `number` | yes | Target X position (pixels) |
| `y` | `number` | yes | Target Y position (pixels) |
| `relative_x` | `number` | — | Relative X movement delta |
| `relative_y` | `number` | — | Relative Y movement delta |

**Example** — the call the suite makes, from `e2e/blocks/06-input.json`, test I-03:

```json
{
  "x": 400,
  "y": 300
}
```

## `trigger_input_action`

Press or release a named Input action (e.g. 'ui_accept', 'jump')

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|:---:|---|
| `action` | `string` | yes | Action name as defined in Project Settings > Input Map |
| `pressed` | `boolean` | — | true = press, false = release (default: true) |
| `strength` | `number` | — | Analog strength 0.0–1.0 (default: 1.0) |

**Example** — the call the suite makes, from `e2e/blocks/06-input.json`, test I-05:

```json
{
  "action": "ui_accept",
  "pressed": true
}
```

## `record_input_sequence`

Record all keyboard and mouse events for a given duration, then return the sequence

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|:---:|---|
| `duration` | `number` | — | How many seconds to record (default: 3, max: 30) |

**Example** — the call the suite makes, from `e2e/blocks/06-input.json`, test I-06:

```json
{
  "duration": 1
}
```

## `replay_input_sequence`

Replay a recorded or manually defined input sequence

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|:---:|---|
| `events` | `array` | yes | Array of events from record_input_sequence or manually defined Array items are `object`. |
| `speed_scale` | `number` | — | Speed multiplier: 2.0 plays back 2× faster, 0.5 plays back 2× slower. Default: 1.0 |

**Example** — the call the suite makes, from `e2e/blocks/06-input.json`, test I-07:

```json
{
  "events": "$INPUT_EVENTS"
}
```

## `configure_input_mapping`

List, add, or remove Input Map actions and their key bindings

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|:---:|---|
| `operation` | `string` | — | Operation to perform (default: list) One of: `"list"`, `"add"`, `"remove"`, `"add_key_binding"`, `"get_events"`. |
| `action_name` | `string` | — | Action name for add/remove/add_key_binding/get_events |
| `key` | `string` | — | Key to bind to action (for add_key_binding) |

**Example** — the call the suite makes, from `e2e/blocks/06-input.json`, test I-08:

```json
{
  "operation": "add",
  "action_name": "test_action_mcp",
  "key": "F12"
}
```
